INTERNAL_CHAT.TITLE: Internal Chat

AUDIT.ON: Audit on — showing all channels (admin). Click to exit.
AUDIT.READONLY_HINT: Audit mode: read-only (you are not in this conversation).
AUDIT.HINT: Shows every conversation in the account. You can only read the ones you are not in.

INTERNAL_CHAT.EMPTY: No conversations yet. Start one with the + button.
INTERNAL_CHAT.SELECT_PROMPT: Select a conversation to start chatting.
INTERNAL_CHAT.SEND_ERROR: Couldn't send the message. Please try again.
INTERNAL_CHAT.ACTION_ERROR: Couldn't complete that action. Please try again.
INTERNAL_CHAT.NO_TEAMS: You are not part of any team.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.SUBTITLE: How you're alerted when a teammate messages you.
NOTIFICATIONS.DESKTOP_HINT: System alert even when the tab is in the background.
NOTIFICATIONS.SOUND_HINT: Play a sound on new messages.
NOTIFICATIONS.BLOCKED: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Enable them in the site settings to get desktop alerts.
NOTIFICATIONS.TONE_NEEDS_SOUND: Turn sound on to pick and hear the tone.

INTERNAL_CHAT.SEARCH_MIN_HINT: Type at least 2 characters to search.

MANAGE.TITLE: Manage group
MANAGE.NAME: Group name
MANAGE.NAME_EMPTY: Give the group a name to save.
MANAGE.NAME_PENDING: Not saved yet — press Enter or Save.
MANAGE.NAME_DISCARDED: The new name was not saved. The group kept its name.
MANAGE.RENAME_ERROR: Could not rename the group. Try again.
MANAGE.REMOVED: {name} is no longer in the group.
MANAGE.REMOVE_Q: Remove {name}? They stop seeing this group.
MANAGE.ALL_IN: Everyone is already in the group.

AUDIO.REQUESTING: Allow the microphone in the browser prompt…
AUDIO.STOP: Stop recording (you can listen before sending)
AUDIO.PERMISSION_DENIED: The browser blocked the microphone. Click the lock next to the site address and allow the microphone.
AUDIO.NO_MIC: No microphone found on this computer.
AUDIO.UNSUPPORTED: This browser can't record audio. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
AUDIO.RECORD_ERROR: Couldn't record the audio. Try again.
AUDIO.SEEK: Move forward or back in the audio
AUDIO.NOT_HEARD: You have not listened to this audio yet

HEADER.DETAILS: See details: participants, photos and files
HEADER.FAVORITE_DONE: Added to favorites, at the top of the list.

MUTE.HINT: No sound or alert. Mentions of you still notify.
MUTE.ACTIVE: Muted conversation: no sound or alert
MUTE.DONE_ON: Conversation muted. Mentions of you still notify.
MUTE.DONE_OFF: Notifications for this conversation are back on.

LIST.TEAMS_HINT: One group per team, with every team member. Click to open.
LIST.EMPTY_HINT: Talk to a teammate or your team without leaving the app.
LIST.NO_UNREAD: All caught up. No conversation with new messages.
LIST.NO_FAVORITES: No favorites. Open a conversation and use ⋮ › Add to favorites.

THREAD.EMPTY_HINT: Type below and press Enter. Use {'@'} to call someone and #123 to point to a customer conversation.
THREAD.NO_MATCH: No message with that text in this conversation.
THREAD.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the messages of this conversation.
THREAD.GO_BOTTOM_NEW: {count} new message(s) · go to the end

COMPOSER.HINT_DM: Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · #123 links a conversation · / canned replies
COMPOSER.HINT_GROUP: Enter sends · {'@'} mentions · #123 links a conversation · / canned replies

BUBBLE.DELIVERED_HINT: Arrived in the chat. Not read yet.
BUBBLE.READ_HINT: Your colleague has read this message.
BUBBLE.FORWARDED_HINT: This message was forwarded from another conversation.

INFO.NO_MEDIA: No photos or files in this conversation yet.
INFO.TITLE: Details

EMPTY_STATE.PICK: Pick a conversation on the side or start a new one.
EMPTY_STATE.FIRST: Talk to teammates and teams without leaving the app. Start your first conversation.
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_MENTION: Use {'@'}name to alert someone in a group
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_CONVERSATION: Type #123 to link straight to a customer conversation
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_SHARE: In a customer conversation, ⋮ › Share to internal chat
EMPTY_STATE.PRIVATE: Internal messages: only your team sees them

CLEAR.TITLE: Clear conversation?
CLEAR.BODY: Messages disappear only from your screen until you reload the page. Nothing is deleted for other participants.

HOME.UNREAD_ONE: You have 1 conversation with new messages.
HOME.UNREAD_MANY: You have {count} conversations with new messages.
HOME.ALL_READ: No new messages. Talk to a colleague or your team without leaving the system.
HOME.ONLINE_HINT: Click a person to send a message.
HOME.NO_ONLINE: Nobody is online right now. Your message waits until they come back.
HOME.TEAMS_HINT: A ready group with the whole team.
HOME.TIP_AUDIO: Record audio with the microphone and listen before sending

PUSH_PROMPT.TITLE: Want to be notified of team messages even with ChatSPX closed?
PUSH_PROMPT.DESCRIPTION: Only direct messages and when someone mentions you. Muted conversations stay quiet.
PUSH_PROMPT.ASKING: Answer the browser prompt at the top of the screen…
PUSH_PROMPT.DONE: Done! You will be notified even with ChatSPX closed.
PUSH_PROMPT.BLOCKED: The browser blocked notifications. Click the lock next to the address to allow them.
PUSH_PROMPT.FAILED: Could not turn on notifications in this browser. Try again later.

SHARE_DRAFT.LABEL: Conversation #{id} goes with your message
SHARE_DRAFT.REMOVE: Remove the conversation from the message
SHARE_DRAFT.GREETING: Hi {name}, can we talk about conversation #{id}?

AUTO_ALERTS.TITLE: Automatic notices

LEAD_PARADO.NAME: Lead waiting
LEAD_PARADO.HINT: Posts here when a round-robin lead goes more than {minutes} min without anyone picking it up. One notice per lead.

META_BATIDA.NAME: Goal reached
META_BATIDA.HINT: Posts here when someone on the team reaches a monthly goal. One notice per person and goal each month.

AUTO_ALERTS.WHO_MANAGES: New notices show up within 5 minutes. Only an admin or the team's supervisor can change this.
AUTO_ALERTS.READ_ONLY: Only an admin or the team's supervisor can turn these on or off.
AUTO_ALERTS.SAVED: Saved. New notices show up within 5 minutes.
AUTO_ALERTS.ERROR: Couldn't save or load. Try again.

LEAVE.TITLE: Leave the group {name}?
LEAVE.BODY: You stop receiving and seeing this group’s messages. You only come back if someone in the group adds you again.

FORWARD.TITLE: Forward message
FORWARD.ERROR: Could not forward. Check your connection and try again.

MESSAGE_INFO.TITLE: Message info
MESSAGE_INFO.READ_AT_HINT: Last time this person opened the conversation
MESSAGE_INFO.ERROR: Could not load who read this message.

STARRED.TITLE: Starred messages
STARRED.EMPTY: No starred messages. In a bubble, ⌄ › Star message.
STARRED.ERROR: Could not load the starred messages.
STARRED.DONE_ON: Message starred. See it in Details › Starred messages.
